summary: Tron Inc., a Nevada crypto-asset finance company formerly known as SRM Entertainment, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 14, 2026 covering an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $200,000,000 of common stock under a sales agreement with Clear Street LLC dated the same day. Sales may be made through the agent or to it as principal, on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with compensation up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. No escrow arrangement applies, no minimum sales are required, and no board recommendation or advisor beyond the sales agent is disclosed. This is a routine shelf takedown and capital-raising facility rather than a special situation. Watch dilution, Nasdaq price pressure at $1.22 versus the earlier $2.15 reference, and any acceleration of share sales.
